description: This file contains TypeScript module declarations and type definitions for the Microsoft Teams SDK, defining external modules, classes, and types related to Microsoft Teams integrations.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Represents a Microsoft Teams application, providing methods to retrieve bot and app graph tokens.

classes.name: Client
classes.description: A client for interacting with Microsoft Teams conversations and activities via the API.

classes.name: JwtValidator
classes.description: A class for validating JWT tokens within the Microsoft Teams authentication middleware.

methods.name: App.constructor
methods.description: Initializes an App instance with clientId, clientSecret, and optional tenantId.

methods.name: App.getBotToken
methods.description: Retrieves a bot token as a Promise resolving to a string or null.

methods.name: App.getAppGraphToken
methods.description: Retrieves an app graph token as a Promise resolving to a string or null.

methods.name: Client.constructor
methods.description: Initializes a Client with a service URL and optional configurations.

methods.name: conversations.activities
methods.description: Returns an object with a create method to send activities in a conversation.

methods.name: JwtValidator.constructor
methods.description: Creates a JwtValidator instance with specified validation options and optional logger.

methods.name: JwtValidator.validateAccessToken
methods.description: Validates a JWT access token and returns a Promise resolving to an object or null.

methods.name: createServiceTokenValidator
methods.description: Creates a function to validate access tokens given an appId and optional tenantId.

methods.name: constructor(options: { clientId: string; clientSecret: string; tenantId?: string }); constructor

ctags.name: constructor
ctags.pattern: /^    constructor(options: { clientId: string; clientSecret: string; tenantId?: string });$/
